notes.title: Update notes for Paddlenoid playtest version 1.0.604
notes.content:
You can now skip in cutscenes by using the mouse buttons as well as space.
The controls menu in options no longer overlaps the 'playtest' banner

notes.title: Paddlenoid 2 - 1.0.603 - Playtest version
notes.content:
Add spotlight + slowdown effect on important events during play
Add 2 minutes to time limit in level 9
Tweak mouse and keyboard sensitivity defaults for new players
Add VSync as a graphic setting. Mouse control is smoother on higher frame rates. On a low refresh rate monitor (60hz) turning off vsync can improve the feel of the game when playing with mouse.

notes.title: Update notes for Paddlenoid playtest version 1.0.602
notes.content:
Fix mouse controls. Full relative positioning which solves a lot of strange 'edge of window' behavior / sluggishness.
Fix keyboard controls. Removed the acceleration profile that made it 'feel weird'.
Fixed height of the options menu
